steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Tecno seems ready with the equipment she's wearing, but her constant ear-scratching tells me otherwise.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Should we act now?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Hold on, we'll wait for her to land first. I don't want to crash into her when I go down.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Hey, hey, hey! Slow down, you're dropping me too fast!

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: She thinks that's fast?

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: She's like a tiny feather falling slowly in the air.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: This isn't the best time to be laughing yourself silly.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: She's in position.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Everything's in place, you can go.
Ela grabs the safety rope with both hands, twists her body out of the window, and stands on the outer wall trying to balance her suspended body against the wind.
She waits until the wind gradually dies down, and frees a hand to straighten her cap that had slanted in the wind as she flashes a smile to Fuze.
Soon after, she lets go of the rope with her remaining hand and disappears out the window, leaving only a rope sliding quickly from the windowsill.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Phew... alright, seems like they managed to connect.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Waahhh—! Why are you here too?!

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Quiet, and pay attention. You almost cut a major cable.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: What happened to those people following you?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Shook them off.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Didn't Papá tell you not to get involved...?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Yeah, he did.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Then why did you come?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: To make sure you don't mess up this project.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Why you...! Are you talking to me like that just because you know what to do?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Well, do you?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Er...

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: I did a quick scan of the puppet's arm controls on the way down here, the hydraulic driver is the one causing the problem. Hand me your tools.
They're right above, hurry!
We would have caught them a long time ago if that woman didn't get in our way.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Heh...

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Time to deal with my troubles.

steps.name: Operating Crew
steps.text: Boss! Good news, the cables are free!

steps.name: Operating Crew Director
steps.text: So soon? Alright, get Tecno back up and we'll get back to assembling the puppets' limbs.

steps.name: Operating Crew
steps.text: She says she wants to stay in there.

steps.name: Operating Crew Director
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: I said, I want to stay here! I'll help out with the installation from here!

steps.name: Operating Crew Director
steps.text: Ah, I'm glad that you want to help us out, but can you promise you won't bother Miss Ela over here?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Say that again and I'll fly right up and smash your face in!

steps.name: Operating Crew Director
steps.text: *ahem* Miss Ela, do you mind if she stays here, for my face's sake?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Of course, Tecno is a loyal friend. She doesn't want me to risk my life all alone at such a height. How can I feel anything other than gratitude?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: *cough* *cough*!

steps.name: Astonished Resident
steps.text: Hey, look! The puppet's arm is moving again!

steps.name: Astonished Resident
steps.text: That's Tecno over there... but why's someone else with her?

steps.name: Confused Resident
steps.text: Who is that? An engineer? A technician? Tecno's assistant?

steps.name: Astonished Resident
steps.text: An assistant? For real? Tecno never liked other people getting involved in her designs.

steps.name: Confused Resident
steps.text: Let me take a look again... Nope, something's blocking my view. Hey, you over there! Can you tell who it is?

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: You talking to me?

steps.name: Confused Resident
steps.text: Yeah, you've been looking that way for a good while now. Can you make out who's with Tecno?

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: You mean Ela? That's a little complicated—

steps.name: Astonished Resident
steps.text: Woah, am I seeing things or did that one just hit Tecno on the head...? The last guy who did something like that almost got a finger bitten off.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Uh, I guess you could say she's... a friend of Tecno's?

steps.name: Community Guard
steps.text: Damn, you slipped away so fast.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Mmph...

steps.name: Community Guard
steps.text: Huh. A tough one, staying silent after tasting one of my punches.

steps.name: Community Guard
steps.text: Get out of the way, unless you plan on dying here!

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Ahhh—!!

steps.name: Community Guard
steps.text: Hold on, Tecno! We'll be right there, that woman won't touch another hair on your head!

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Get your hands off me! What are you up to?!

steps.name: Community Guard
steps.text: Get away from the window!

steps.name: Community Guard
steps.text: Tecno! Are you alright?!

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Wh-Why are you up there?

steps.name: Community Guard
steps.text: Papá sent me to watch these foreigners and I heard you screaming, what did that woman do to you?! I'll be down to help right away!

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Uh, no, it's nothing, I'm fine... I just... just...

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: I only bopped her on the head.

steps.name: Community Guard
steps.text: Did it hurt?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Community Guard
steps.text: Then why did you scream?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: I... uh, anyway, I'm totally fine, you guys go back and tell Papá everything's okay. I'll watch her and nothing will go wrong.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Tecno. Pass me the soldering tools, thanks.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Here you go.

steps.name: Community Guard
steps.text: (Whispering) She's... willing to play assistant...?

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: See, they're working so well together. Everything's okay, right?

steps.name: Operating Crew
steps.text: The puppets are all done, boss!

steps.name: Operating Crew Director
steps.text: Phew... is everyone ready? Amigos, this is the hardest part.

steps.name: Operating Crew Director
steps.text: We must give them a pulse. Give them blood, vitality, life.

steps.name: Operating Crew
steps.text: I've been ready for a while, boss. Give the order.

steps.name: Operating Crew Director
steps.text: Hello, everyone. After more than six months of hard work and dedication, we've overcome our obstacles and finally arrived at the end. Thank you all for sticking with it.

steps.name: Operating Crew Director
steps.text: Listen up, everybody. Our first rehearsal is about to begin.

steps.name: Operating Crew Director
steps.text: Come on, girls. Let's bat those eyelashes.

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: They're alive.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: I've pictured this many times.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: From the flyers, design drafts, and what everyone was saying... I figured I'd have to compromise on my design, that the pair could never be what I wanted them to be.

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: What about now, looking at them with your own eyes?

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: All I can say is... it's beyond what I could've imagined myself.
Iana is once again struck by their beautiful faces and delicate construction as she looks at the two puppets blinking away.
They looked like beautiful art installations when they were standing still, but their movements have now transformed them into the two most beautiful girls in town.
Iana is unable to glimpse their eyes as their thick lashes lower too quickly for her to get a good look.
Suddenly, one of them lowers her head, turning toward Iana. Her lower eyelashes lift without dropping back down, and their gazes meet.
A pair of vermillion pupils.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Why are her eyes orange?

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: It's the morning sun reflecting in them. She'll dance under the sun as much as she likes.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Oh, so it's the sun making that color.

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: You know, we originally wanted to have their eyes in black because it'd be easier. But Tecno disagreed, she thinks black is the worst color to pair with the sun.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: No, she's got it wrong.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: The worst color to pair with the sun is actually white.
The puppets begin to stretch their limbs as the crowd cheers on. Moving each joint takes a group of people and all their strength, shouting as they pull the rope in unison.

steps.name: Operating Crew Director
steps.text: On pull! Uno, dos, tres, pull!

steps.name: Operating Crew
steps.text: Gargh—!
The puppets lift their knees, and take a step forward.

steps.name: Operating Crew Director
steps.text: Alright, everyone! Uno, dos, tres, release!

steps.name: Operating Crew
steps.text: Eargh——!
The puppets wave their arms and brush them against their sides.

steps.name: Operating Crew Director
steps.text: Okay, uno, dos, tres, again!

steps.name: Operating Crew
steps.text: Hyah———!
They walk briskly through the residential buildings along a path made by the spectators, occasionally bending down to fit below the skyways.
They eventually stop in the neighborhood's central square.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: One, two, three! Argh—!

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Thanks, friend.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Want to find a better spot to enjoy the show?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: I'm good, the view from this window isn't bad.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: What time is it...? Yes, almost here.
As the sky gradually darkens and the twin moons rise from the far side of the city, the moonlit concrete floor appears to resemble a frozen lake in winter.
As the two puppet dancers twirl on the ground, the moonlight highlights their bodies as they move to the castanets' rhythm, alternating between straightening and twisting.
Music pours out from the skyscrapers, roofs, alleys, and even some dimly lit windows.
This is an impromptu ensemble performance, without a rehearsal or conductor.
The sounds flow freely along with the puppet dancers' choreography.
Their skirts catch the notes landing at their feet, transforming them into a part of their beautiful dance.
The tall puppets lower their heads, watching those at their feet.
Those people, small and light as a feather, follow in their dance steps.
They leap into the air and come back down to the ground.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Still think I wasn't talking sense?

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: (Shakes head)

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: It was well worth it.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: So you were willing to help them out because you envisioned something like this?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: No, I never thought of it that way. It wouldn't have been fun otherwise.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Woah, amazing. Who taught you the harmonica?

steps.name: Small Child
steps.text: It was Mama, she can do anything, she can play this, she can dance, she can draw, she can even bake super yummy ker-sonts.

steps.name: Small Child
steps.text: Mama is my favorite person!

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: I have the utmost respect for this superhuman woman, but I must insist—it should be pronounced 'Cwuh-son'!

steps.name: Small Child
steps.text: ......Quaso?

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Hahahaha—!

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Ugh... forget it.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: I'm going to get some coffee.

steps.name: Restorationist
steps.text: Señor Reynell, I've finished inspecting the box, and it'll take a few weeks to repair it.

steps.name: Restorationist
steps.text: But I've managed to reproduce a portion of the drum according to that hidden score. Would you like to hear it?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Yes...
A melody pours out of the box, bringing Reynell back more than a decade, to a time when he hid behind a door to eavesdrop on the tinkling coming from his mother's workshop.

steps.name: Restorationist
steps.text: Judging by this little bit I've restored, it must be a lullaby.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: An extremely simple tune.

steps.name: Restorationist
steps.text: Yes, I was surprised when I first heard it, because I recall that your mother crafted elaborate melodies into her older works.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: She wrote this piece herself...

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: She's no professional composer, but she, as a mother, wrote this simple lullaby for her child.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Nothing special about it.

steps.name: Restorationist
steps.text: But it must be special to that child, at least.

steps.name: Restorationist
steps.text: Señor Reynell... you've been staring out the window this whole time, is something there?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Nothing much, just watching the moons rise.
